title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Protocol Using Qiagen Hybrid Method
author: Donald J. MacKenzie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4q4gvyw
materials: Continue with step 6 of the RNeasy Mini Protocol for Isolation of Total RNA from Plant Cells and Tissues and Filamentous Fungi in the RNeasy Mini Handbook. RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Protocol 6: pBIOZOL and Qiagen RNeasy Plant Mini Kit Method by Eric Carpenter

steps.title: Grind Sample
steps.instruction: Grind up to 50 mg of sample in liquid nitrogen to a fine powder using a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the tissue powder and liquid nitrogen to an appropriately sized tube and allow the liquid nitrogen to evaporate without allowing the sample to thaw.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer and sarkosyl to the tissue powder and vortex.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL lysis buffer to a maximum of 50 mg of tissue powder.

steps.title: Incubate Lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 70 °C in a water bath or heating block for 10 minutes with vigorous shaking or intermittent vortexing (omit this step for samples with high starch content to prevent swelling).

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove cell debris using a QIAshredder Spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Pipet the lysate directly onto a QIAshredder Spin Column (lilac-colored, RNeasy Plant Mini Kit) placed in a 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at maximum speed (> [rcf]).
Carefully transfer the supernatant of the flow-through fraction to a new microcentrifuge tube, ensuring the cell-debris pellet in the collection tube is not disturbed.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to the lysate and mix.

substeps.instruction: If lysate was lost during homogenization, reduce the ethanol volume proportionally.
